input.claim_text: On 3 February 2024 a candle I left burning on the lounge room shelf tipped over and caught the curtains on fire. The flames spread quickly and scorched part of the wall and carpet before I managed to put it out with a wet towel. I haven't had anyone come look at the damage yet so I don't know what it'll cost to fix. My policy number is HC-882913. (Policyholder with NRMA home insurance.)

output.cause: candle tip over and catch curtains on fire
output.damaged_item: wall and carpet in lounge room

turns.text:
DECISION: escalate

Reasoning: The claim narrative provides no repair estimate or invoice, and `extract_fields` returned a null `estimated_amount` that cannot be resolved from any other information in the claim (the policyholder explicitly states no assessor has inspected the damage yet). Per escalation policy, a null estimated_amount that cannot be resolved another way requires human review rather than a guessed figure. I have not proceeded to calculate a payout since there is no claim amount to compute against, and pulling policy certificate/coverage figures now would be premature until a damage estimate exists.

Escalating for a human to follow up once a repair quote/assessment is obtained, at which point coverage (fire/accidental damage peril) and the NRMA excess/coverage limit can be properly evaluated.
